name: Minnesota Equipment
old_description: Curious what your current equipment is worth? Minnesota Equipment offers quick, reliable evaluations so you can make confident decisions about selling, trading, or upgrading.
about:
Minnesota Equipment is based in Rogers, Minnesota, where it operates as a licensed John Deere dealer providing new and used equipment, parts, and service for yard and farm work. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The dealership carries a range of outdoor power equipment including mowers, compact tractors, utility tractors, hay equipment, utility vehicles, snowblowers, and handheld tools. It stocks parts for most brands and offers service and repair for the equipment it sells. Trade-in evaluations are available for customers looking to upgrade their machinery.

Minnesota Equipment serves residential customers, commercial landscaping crews, agricultural operators, and government agencies. Its marketing segments reference adventurers, weekend warriors, multi-taskers, groundbreakers, and harvest heroes, reflecting a focus on both hobbyist and professional users in grounds maintenance and farming.

The company emphasizes quick, reliable trade-in evaluations and a broad parts inventory as reasons customers choose it, though it does not publish a formal mission statement or founding narrative.
